spans.text: Each Day Is Unique and Gets Us Closer to Shabbos—and Closer to Mashiach!

Each day, as part of the avodah in the Beis Hamikdash, the Leviim sang a different "song" (chapter of Tehillim) that (according to the Gemara) represents that day's aspect of Creation. In the hope that soon the Beis Hamikdash will be rebuilt, we also recite songs every day. By counting the days in reference to Shabbos (היום יום...בשבת), we fulfill the mitzvah to remember the Shabbos every day. In addition, this ties our daily successes to Shabbos, rather than to the planets (which is the source of the non-Jewish names of each day). According to the Zohar, each chapter connects to a different millennium of the seven one-thousand-year periods from Creation, thus each "day" gets us closer to יום שכולו שבת—"Shabbos"—the coming of Mashiach.
הַיּוֹם, יוֹם רִאשׁוֹן בְּשַׁבָּת, שֶׁבּוֹ הָיוּ הַלְוִיִּם אוֹמְרִים בְּבֵית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ:

לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר—The entire earth belongs to Hashem. Therefore, who will succeed here and be worthy of blessings? Only those who are sincere in the service of Hashem, who use this material world for noble goals and who deal with others with honesty and integrity! We hope for the day when all of civilization will recognize Hashem and live by these values.

שִׁיר מִזְמוֹר לִבְנֵי קֹרַח—The city of Yerushalayim was chosen by Hashem as His special place where He will reveal His greatness to the nations of the world. And just as Yerushalayim (with its unique kedushah and beauty) is to be an example to us of how to conduct our lives, so, too, we are to be an example to the world and be a model for others to emulate. And as the unique status of
Yerushalayim is eternal, so, too, our unique relationship with Hashem is eternal.

—מִזְמוֹר  The continued existence of the world is dependent on justice and the fair application of laws. Since justice is ultimately in the Hands of Hashem—all judges—including all of us who are constantly judging our fellow men—must act with honesty and integrity. Our opinions and decisions (about how we treat people) have a great effect on the world.

—אֵל נְקָמוֹת How long will the forces of evil be victorious? They trample Bnei Yisrael, oppressing widows and orphans, claiming that You, Hashem, do not see or care! How foolish are they to think that way! Hashem, judge them and repay them with what they deserve. We understand that all You do to us as a nation and individually is for our good. You will never abandon us, and therefore we sing Your praises as our great King Who controls everything.
הַיּוֹם, יוֹם שֵׁנִי בְּשַׁבָּת, שֶׁבּוֹ הָיוּ הַלְוִיִּם אוֹמְרִים בְּבֵית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ:
הַיּוֹם, יוֹם שְׁלִישִׁי בַּשַּׁבָּת, שֶׁבּוֹ הָיוּ הַלְוִיִּם אוֹמְרִים בְּבֵית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ:
הַיּוֹם, יוֹם רְבִיעִי בַּשַּׁבָּת, שֶׁבּוֹ הָיוּ הַלְוִיִּם אוֹמְרִים בְּבֵית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ:
